content: मन्त्रिन् {%a.%} [मन्त्रयते मन्त्र् णिनि] .²1 Wise, clever in counsel. .²2 Familiar with sacred texts or spells. .²3 <ab>Ved.</ab> Eloquent. --{%m.%} .²1 A minister, counsellor, a kingʼs minister; अजिताधिगमाय मन्त्रिभिर्युयुजे नीतिविशारदैरजः <ls>R. 8. 17</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 1</ls>. .²2 A conjurer, an enchanter. .²3 (In chess) The queen. .²4 (In <ab>astrol.</ab>) The 12th mansion.
